guideIntro: A starting point for organising your questions. Requirements for your situation should be confirmed with the team and the relevant authorities.
guideText1: Describe the purpose of your stay and the guidance you need. The team will help identify the next steps for your case.
guideText2: Have references from previous appointments ready and prepare a list of questions. Do not send personal documents through this form.
guideText3: Use the reference provided by AAAI to request an update. The team will reply through your chosen channel.
faq1: Does a request guarantee an appointment?
faqAnswer1: Your chosen date is a preference. The AAAI team will confirm availability and appointment details.
faq2: Does this show a live case status?
faqAnswer2: Use the reference and code on your receipt to check the status recorded by the team. Older requests without a code are handled through the contact channels.
faqAnswer3: This form does not accept files. Ask the team about required documents and the appropriate channel for your case.

dataInfo.heading: How appointment data is used
dataInfo.collection: The form records your name, email, optional phone, service, preferred date/time, notes and consent given on submission. These details are used to manage and respond to your request.
dataInfo.storage: Requests are stored in AAAI’s WordPress installation. This module’s management panel is restricted to administrators. Do not include personal documents or passport numbers in notes.
dataInfo.lookup: Tracking requires a reference and access code. It shows only status, confirmed date and the message marked as public by the team. It does not return contact details, form notes or internal notes.
dataInfo.contact: The form does not save these details in browser local storage, and this module does not send emails automatically. The team deletes records manually; there is no automatic retention schedule yet. Contact AAAI to ask about, correct or remove your details.
